long_biography.plain_text:
Mary Louise Schilke Miller helped sustain Biomet's earliest years after the orthopedic-device company began in a converted Warsaw, Indiana, barn. She and her family lived frugally, guaranteed startup debt and performed practical office work while Dane Miller and his partners built the business. SEC records later documented Mary Louise as a joint Biomet shareholder during the company's 2007 sale.

After Dane's death, Miller became the principal public steward of their family philanthropy. As president of the Dr. Dane and Mary Louise Miller Foundation, she supported education, biomedical science, local development and community organizations around Winona Lake and Warsaw. She had also founded and owned ML Motorsports, a professional racing team that competed for fifteen years before closing in 2014.
